limitations: The ~500 number is a self-reported one-day My Feed referrer event count, not deduplicated people or verified commercial orders.
The two other creators' reviews and their follower audiences are the reported exposure mechanism; neither event is a game-author devlog release or game update.
Indexing changes, genre tags, recommendation placement, other reviews, outside outreach and time trends are uncontrolled.
Follower counts cannot be added to obtain reachable unique viewers because follow graphs may overlap and not all followers view posts.
Downloads and reviews are not retained positive-price game orders, and no valid buyer or seller profit denominator is supplied.
Single voluntary publisher is not a representative paid 2D game seller sample; metrics lack independent first-party dashboard authentication.
